title: Acquirer: Police Credit Union Limited; Target: Softwoods Credit Union Cooperative Limited

body_sections.Summary: Softwoods proposes to transfer all of its business assets to PCU.
body_sections.Competition analysis: No direct overlap between outlets of parties concerned.  Customers of Softwoods will have greater accesss to facilities from PCU. Softwoods and PCU compete against a range of other financial institutions, such that proposed transaction does not raise competition concerns.
